extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers, journal editors, and publishers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for peer reviewers and journals on joining and using the Reviewer Credits cross-publisher platform to find, match, recognize, reward, and certify peer review activity. Covers reviewer-facing features (matching, recognition, training) and publisher-facing benefits (finding reviewers, certifying processes, saving time/costs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Get recognized and rewarded for your peer reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform offers acknowledgment and formal recognition for review activity (e.g., certifications and profile visibility) so reviewers receive credit for their contributions; useful when building CVs and academic reputation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best-fit review request matching
rubrics_metrics.description: Receive best-fit review requests from leading journals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The service matches reviewers to appropriate review requests (based on fit/expertise) to improve assignment relevance and reviewer satisfaction; intended to reduce mismatches and increase review acceptance rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Earn trusted and acknowledged certification for your activity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-publisher certification documents reviewer contributions and skills; this certification is positioned as evidence of reviewer activity and competence for career advancement or institutional recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Skill development and training
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop your skills with the Peer Reviewer Power-Up Course
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform-provided training (webinars, courses, podcasts) to help reviewers improve reviewing competence and stay current with peer review best practices; intended to make reviewers more effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic profile and reputation building
rubrics_metrics.description: Build your academic reputation with an all-in-one profile, to grow your career
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining a public profile on the platform aggregates review activity and credentials to showcase contributions and support professional development and visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer motivation and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Find best-fit peer reviewers quickly who are motivated and available
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For journals, the platform emphasizes locating reviewers who are both suitable in expertise and currently available/interested, addressing common bottlenecks in reviewer recruitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer rewards / credits
rubrics_metrics.description: Reward reviewers with credits redeemable for services and rewards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetizable or redeemable credits are used as incentives to recognize reviewer effort; these credits can be exchanged for services or other rewards offered by the platform or partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal/process certification to increase credibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Get certified for your peer review process to increase your journal’s credibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journals can obtain certification for their review processes (a cross-publisher certification) which is positioned as enhancing trustworthiness and signaling quality to authors/readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time and cost savings
rubrics_metrics.description: Save time and expense with our one-stop solution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform claims operational efficiencies for editors and publishers (reduced time spent finding reviewers, lower administrative costs) through a centralised reviewer recruitment and reward system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expediting the publication cycle
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By improving reviewer recruitment, matching, incentives, and process efficiency, the platform aims to shorten review turnarounds and speed up time-to-publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protecting research and publishing integrity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer recognition, certification, and curated reviewer networks are framed as mechanisms to uphold standards, ensure quality assurance, and guard against misconduct or low-quality reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer retention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Through recognition, rewards, and streamlined engagement, the platform seeks to keep reviewers engaged over time, reducing churn and recurring recruitment burdens for journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable, publisher-independent peer review network
rubrics_metrics.description: Building a sustainable, publisher independent, and efficient peer review network to support quality assurance processes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on an interoperable, cross-publisher infrastructure that is not tied to a single publisher — intended to create longevity, neutrality, and scalability in reviewer recruitment and QA support.
